fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/LatestModelsByCategory.cy.js#Homepage - LatestModelsByCategory [ta] TC-LMC-02: first product name on default tab navigates to truck PDP
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LMC-02
**Title:** First product name on default tab navigates to truck PDP
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
On the default category tab, click the first visible truck product name and confirm the truck product detail page opens.

**Expected Result:**
The browser URL matches that product’s truck PDP path for the selected language.

**Steps:**
1. Open Latest Models by Category
2. Click the first visible product name on the active tab
3. Verify the URL is the matching truck PDP
descriptionHtml:
Test Case ID: TC-LMC-02
Title: First product name on default tab navigates to truck PDP
Language: ta

Description:
On the default category tab, click the first visible truck product name and confirm the truck product detail page opens.

Expected Result:
The browser URL matches that product’s truck PDP path for the selected language.

Steps:

  1. Open Latest Models by Category
  2. Click the first visible product name on the active tab
  3. Verify the URL is the matching truck PDP
